På ESSIQ handlar det om att sätta medarbetaren i centrum. Genom ett lyhört ledarskap och en öppen företagskultur vill vi ge varje medarbetare möjligheten att forma sin karriär och sin vardag.


Till den här rollen söker vi dig som har erfarenhet av relevanta uppgifter och som är redo för nya utmaningar. Ser du fördelarna med att få variation och erfarenhet från olika kunder och branscher men att utvecklas med en och samma arbetsgivare? Som medarbetare på ESSIQ får du det bästa av två världar.

#### **ROLLBESKRIVNING**


Som test- och verifieringsingenjör arbetar du på plats hos någon av våra kunder, som är ledande tillverkare av lastbilar, bussar och personbilar i Göteborgsregionen. Du säkerställer att mjukvara och elektriska system fungerar som de ska innan de släpps till produktion: från kravnedbrytning och testdesign till exekvering, felsökning och rapportering. Beroende på uppdrag och din profil ligger tyngdpunkten på systemverifiering i rigg och HIL-miljö, test i fordon, fordonsdiagnostik och fault tracing, eller testautomation. Typiska områden är telematik och connectivity, elektrisk drivlina och batteri, förarstöd samt fordonets elektriska system. Du arbetar nära mjukvaruutvecklare, systemansvariga och verifieringsteam i internationella miljöer, och du är den som driver avvikelser till rotorsak och bidrar till att releasen blir godkänd. Vi förväntar oss att du har ett användarcentrerat, lösningsorienterat arbetssätt och att du är öppen, nytänkande och professionell. En anställning hos oss innebär både trygghet och frihet, där vi stöttar dig så mycket som du vill och behöver. För oss är det viktigt att du får vara delaktig i att forma din karriärväg och att du är med och påverkar ESSIQ som företag och arbetsplats.

#### **KVALIFIKATIONER**


Vi letar inte efter anställda, vi letar efter medarbetare – efter ESSIQ:are! Nedanstående är de grundläggande kvalifikationerna för tjänsten, men vi kommer även lägga stor vikt vid din personlighet.

**Grundläggande kvalifikationer**

* Civil- eller högskoleingenjör inom elektroteknik, mekatronik, datateknik eller motsvarande
* Minimum 5 års arbetslivserfarenhet av test och verifiering, gärna inom fordon eller annan produktutvecklande industri
* Erfarenhet av verifiering i rigg, HIL-miljö eller fordon, gärna både manuell och automatiserad testning
* Kunskap om fordonskommunikation som CAN, LIN och Ethernet, och vana vid verktyg som CANoe, CANalyzer eller CAPL
* Erfarenhet av kravbaserad testning, från kravnedbrytning och testfall till rapportering och uppföljning
* Behärskar engelska i tal och skrift. Svenska är meriterande.
* Har rätt att arbeta i Sverige

**Meriterande**

* Erfarenhet av fordonsdiagnostik och fault tracing, gärna med UDS
* Erfarenhet från telematik och connectivity, elektrisk drivlina och batteri, eller ADAS
* Python för testautomation, dSPACE eller kunskap om ISO 26262

**Personlighet och engagemang**

* Du är **ansvarstagande** – kommer i mål, i medvind likväl som i motvind.
* Du är **social och kommunikativ** – öppen och tydlig gentemot dina kollegor, och är en produktiv problemlösare. Du är bra på att föra samtal om dig, arbetsteamet och leveransen inför en eller flera åhörare.
* Du är **lyhörd och hjälpsam** – tar in kunskap från omvärld och kollegor, och delar gärna med dig av din egen. Du är generös med tips, hjälp och stöd.

#### **OM TJÄNSTEN**

* Anställningsform: tillsvidareanställning på heltid. 6 månaders provanställning tillämpas.
* Tillträde: enligt överenskommelse.
* Lön och förmåner: Konkurrenskraftig fast eller rörlig lön. Goda utvecklingsmöjligheter och generösa förmåner. Tjänstepension, omfattande försäkringar.
* Placering: ESSIQ Väst – på plats hos kund i Göteborg med omnejd.

#### **OM ESSIQ**


ESSIQ är teknikkonsultföretaget där allt börjar med dig. Med fokus på individen, flexibla lösningar och en modern lönepolicy attraherar vi de skarpaste, mest professionella och engagerade personerna i branschen. Med denna vision grundades ESSIQ år 2005, sedan dess har vi utvecklats till ett framgångsrikt företag med kontor i Stockholm, Göteborg och Malmö. Vi består idag av över 250 medarbetare med olika bakgrund, personlighet och nationalitet, med en god fördelning av kvinnor och män.


Vi har över 80 aktiva kunder i spännande branscher – allt från de stora aktörerna till de små innovationsföretagen. ESSIQ:s medarbetare arbetar med användarcentrerad tjänste- och produktutveckling inom följande tjänsteområden: UX & Service Design, Connected & Embedded Systems, IT & Cloud Services, Green Technology & Electromobility, Test & Quality Engineering, Agile Management, Mechanical Engineering samt Simulation & Visualization. Kompetensen levererar vi på plats hos uppdragsgivaren, inhouse och i satellit. Våra medarbetares intressen och ambitioner leder vägen – vårt mål är att göra den perfekta matchningen av individ och uppdrag.


ESSIQ är ett familjärt och socialt företag med visionen att vara Sveriges bästa arbetsgivare för alla medarbetare, oavsett roll i organisationen. Vi lägger stor vikt vid gemenskap och har ett uppskattat utbud av professionella och sociala aktiviteter. Vår kommunikationsplattform genomsyras av öppenhet, och främjar nätverkande och kompetensutbyte såväl som fritidsaktiviteter och relationsbyggande.

#### **ANSÖKAN**


Vi använder oss av rekryteringsverktyget Teamtailor. Ansök senast den 6/12-2026. Urval sker löpande och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag.

#### **KONTAKT**


Frågor om tjänsten? Kontakta: Henrik Vidarsson, henrik.vidarsson@essiq.se, 0705-21 81 42.


Vill du veta mer om ESSIQ? Besök http://essiq.se och följ oss på våra sociala medier!

title: Design Manager - Retail Tech
description:
**Job Description** **WHAT YOU’LL DO**


As a Design Manager within Retail Tech, you’ll lead and grow a team of digital product designers shaping the experiences that power everyday work across H&M stores globally. You’ll champion design quality and turn complex retail challenges into intuitive solutions that create meaningful impact for our colleagues, customers and business.

* Lead, coach and develop designers through clear feedback, individual growth plans and continuous learning.
* Ensure end-to-end experience quality across usability, accessibility, consistency and brand direction.
* Plan design capacity and allocate resources across areas and product teams to meet current and future needs.
* Improve collaboration, workflows and governance across design, product, engineering, operations and brand.
* Guide the adoption and continuous improvement of relevant design systems to deliver consistent experiences at scale.
* Strengthen design maturity and ways of working across Retail Tech, enabling designers to work more strategically and create greater impact.
* Define and track design KPIs, using research insights and performance data to improve user and business outcomes.
* Build an inclusive team culture based on trust, wellbeing, engagement and sustainable performance.

**WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH**


You will lead and develop a team of digital product designers, supporting their growth and enabling high-quality design delivery. As part of an area leadership trio, you will work closely with the Area Business Manager and Area Tech Manager, as well as partners across Product, Engineering, Operations, Brand, research and analytics.

**WHO YOU ARE**


We are looking for people with…

* Extensive experience in digital product or UX design, including significant experience leading design teams and directly managing people.
* Proven responsibility for team allocation, capacity planning, design delivery and quality across products, services or digital platforms.
* Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to create clarity and alignment across product, technology, design and business stakeholders.
* Experience coaching designers and building inclusive, high-performing teams.
* Strong knowledge of human-centred, interaction and product design, including service design and journey management methodologies.
* Experience working with design systems at scale and advanced Figma skills. Knowledge of Material Design is an advantage.
* Experience using research and data to guide decisions, define priorities and measure outcomes.
* Knowledge of accessibility standards, including WCAG 2.1 AA, and inclusive design practices.
* Experience with AI-supported design and curiosity to keep learning as the field develops.


And people who are…

* Collaborative and able to build trust across disciplines and seniority levels.
* Clear, transparent and confident when communicating recommendations, rationale, risks and decisions.
* Customer-focused, with the ability to balance user needs with product and commercial goals.
* Empowering and committed to creating the conditions for others to grow and succeed.
* Proactive, resourceful and comfortable navigating change and complex organisational environments.

  

**Additional Information** **WHO WE ARE**


H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.


We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future.

**WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE**


At H&M Group, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe.

* An influential leadership role where you can shape design quality, capability and ways of working at scale.
* The opportunity to work across digital and physical customer and colleague experiences in a global organisation.
* A collaborative environment where design, business and technology work together to create meaningful outcomes.

**JOIN US**


Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things: our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it is our people who make us who we are.


Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here.

*We are committed to a recruitment process that is fair, equitable, and based on competency. We therefore kindly ask you not to attach a cover letter to your application.*

title: Head of Digital – E-com to Lindex, Gothenburg
description:
The opportunity This is an opportunity to shape digital e-commerce within a company that operates its infrastructure in-house and retains responsibility for the stability and development of its platforms. Lindex has established digital channels and a customer base of approximately six million members. You lead a team of managers, leaders, UX designers and software developers. The role combines long-term direction with practical responsibility for platform performance, personalisation and customer journey development, giving you the opportunity to influence how technology supports business results.
  
  

About the role You are a senior digital leader with a strong commercial mindset and a proven ability to connect digital strategy with business performance. You understand how e-commerce, data, AI and technology drive growth, profitability and customer experience, and know how to translate business ambitions into clear digital priorities, roadmaps and measurable results. You bring extensive experience leading complex digital ecosystems, including websites, apps and commerce platforms, and understand how these contribute to the broader retail business and customer journey. With a strong focus on commercial performance, you drive the development of digital capabilities that strengthen customer engagement, personalisation and conversion while ensuring scalable, efficient and high-performing platforms.
  
  

As an influential and collaborative leader, you align business and technology stakeholders around shared priorities, balance operational excellence with innovation and drive continuous digital development. You also drive digital maturity, AI adoption and competence development, strengthening the organisation’s ability to capture new opportunities and maintain a competitive position in a rapidly evolving market. The Head of Digital – E-com holds full accountability for the business team's digital direction, capabilities and contribution to commercial, financial, operational, sustainability and people performance. The role reports to the Chief Digital Officer (CDO).
  
  

Key responsibilities Define the strategic digital direction and roadmap e-commerce. Lead the development and operation of Lindex app, website, commerce backend and continuous improvements. Ensure stable, secure and reliable platforms with minimal disruption. Deliver word-class customer journeys, platform performance and conversion.
  
  

Elevate personalisation across Lindex digital customer experience. Translate commercial objectives into technology priorities, digital capabilities and delivery plans. Lead the work and strengthen the use of data, artificial intelligence, automation and modern digital ways of working. Lead a team of digital professionals, including software developers, UX designers and digital managers.
  
  

Contribute to the overall digital transformation as part of the Digital & Tech Management Team, driving digital competence development, AI adoption and new ways of working across the organisation. Establish strategic leadership and clear ownership of digital partners and suppliers, ensuring strong performance and alignment with business objectives. About you You combine strategic digital leadership with the ability to turn customer and business needs into clear technology priorities. You consider the trade-offs between operational stability, continuous improvement and new capabilities.
  
  

As a leader, you create clarity across teams and reporting lines, develop people and communicate complex decisions in a direct and accessible way. To succeed in the role, you need: A relevant university degree or equivalent professional experience. Extensive experience in digital development and technology within a business context. Leadership experience from digital products, platforms or customer-facing technology.
  
  

Documented experience of translating business strategy into digital capabilities and execution. Experience developing robust digital customer journeys, e-commerce solutions or comparable high-volume services. Experience leading agile delivery, roadmaps and backlog prioritisation across multiple disciplines. Strong communication skills and fluency in English.
  
  

**It is an advantage if you have:** Experience with personalisation, data, analytics, automation and AI Experience improving digital conversion and customer experience. Experience leading across reporting lines and shared areas of responsibility. Experience from retail, e-commerce or another industry with complex, customer-facing digital platforms. Experience from fashion, apparel, retail or another design-led product environment.
  
  

Location and Application The position is based at the company’s head office in Gothenburg and requires regular on-site presence. International travel may be required. We warmly welcome your application by 22 November via maquire.se (https://maquire.se/lediga-jobb/). If you have any questions, please contact Igor Glavan, 0701-765828, igor.glavan@jerrie.se or Jonna Berglöv, 0763-034100, jonna.berglov@jerrie.se Maquire applies a fair selection process based on a clearly defined role profile.
  
  

We do not use AI for screening or selection. Every application is reviewed by a human.

title: Technical Lead
description:
**Job Summary**
---------------



**Description:**  

  

**Who we are looking for**  

**We are looking for a collaborative frontend software engineer who is motivated by creating value for users and helping a team succeed. You communicate clearly, listen to different viewpoints, and share your knowledge in a supportive way. You are comfortable asking questions, giving and receiving feedback, and helping colleagues grow.**  

**You bring strong frontend capability and enjoy working in a cross-functional environment. You can take ownership of complex work while also sharing routine, maintenance, and support tasks with the team. You are willing to contribute outside your primary specialty when priorities require it, and you approach unfamiliar areas with curiosity and a learning mindset.**  

**You use analysis, experimentation, and critical thinking to navigate complexity. You care about quality, security, maintainability, and continuous improvement, and you balance technical decisions with customer and business value.**  

**We do not expect one person to know everything. If you meet many of the requirements and believe you can grow into the role, we encourage you to apply. Relevant capability may have been gained through employment, consulting, education, open-source work, personal projects, or another path.**  

  

**How we work together**  

**We collaborate within and across teams, support each other’s development, and build trust through open dialogue and shared responsibility. Work from the team backlog—including exploration, development, testing, maintenance, and support—is owned collectively rather than assigned according to status or specialty alone.**  

**We want everyone to be able to contribute, be heard, and develop. We evaluate candidates against the capabilities needed for the role and welcome applications from people of all genders, ages, nationalities, cultures, and career backgrounds.**  

  

**Essential capabilities**  

**Demonstrated ability to develop and maintain complex web applications using a modern frontend framework such as React or Angular, together with TypeScript.**  

**Automated build, test, and deployment workflows using Azure and GitHub Actions**  

**Ability to design usable, responsive, accessible, and performant interfaces.**  

**Understanding of secure-by-design practices for web applications.**  

**Experience working collaboratively in an agile, cross-functional software team.**  

**Ability to communicate effectively in spoken and written English in an international working environment.**  

**Willingness to share knowledge and contribute across the team’s workload when needed.**  

  

**Additional capabilities that would be valuable**  

**Web Components and styling approaches such as Bootstrap, CSS-in-JS, Styled Components, or Tailwind.**  

**UX practices such as Lean UX and Design Thinking.**  

**Asynchronous programming, microservice architecture, cloud services, or test-automation frameworks.**  

**Backend development, particularly Java and the Spring framework.**  

**Designing and consuming REST APIs.**  

**Application architecture, DevOps, or broader system-development experience.**


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


**The Mission**  

**The Volvo Group Engineers are committed to develop 100% fossil free, 100% safe products. As a part of the Volvo Group digital transformation, we are developing the next generation tools to manage the product platform that aims to support the engineers on this challenging journey. We aim to reshape the user experience with much better assistance and help to automate both small and complex tasks.**  

  

**What you will do**  

**As a Frontend Software Engineer, you will take an active role in developing modern, accessible, secure, and responsive user interfaces for tools used by Volvo Group engineers worldwide. You will contribute hands-on code, influence frontend design and engineering practices, and help the team establish sustainable technical standards. In this, you will of course have great support from other colleagues and experts!**  

**An important part of the role is sharing knowledge through collaboration, feedback, coaching, and practical examples. You will also contribute beyond your main frontend expertise - for example, by supporting testing, maintenance, incident resolution, documentation, or selected backend tasks. We value people who combine deep expertise with curiosity about the wider product: a T-shaped way of working that helps the whole team succeed.**  

  

**Join our digital transformation**  

**At Group Digital Technology & Operations (DTO), we have a clear commitment to enable value creation at scale for the Volvo Group. With a product centric operating model and digital technologies, we produce digital offerings that are profitable, scalable, and differentiated. With DTO, you will be part of a global and diverse team of highly skilled professionals, who learn continuously and embrace change to stay ahead. We have a very important role to play in reaching the Volvo Group ambitions.**  

**If you want to help strengthen Volvo Group’s digital capabilities and make a practical difference for engineering teams, we would like to hear from you.**  

  

**Your future team**  

**We are one of four teams developing and maintaining the core application within the product development at Volvo (KOLA) – the heart of Volvo product documentation. The team works together at Lindholmen in Gothenburg, Sweden.**  

**Our cross-functional product team includes software engineers, a solution architect, a Scrum Master, and a Product Owner. We share responsibility for the full product lifecycle and work with DevSecOps practices. Open dialogue, respect, and constructive challenge are central to how we collaborate. We welcome colleagues with different backgrounds, identities, nationalities, ages, career paths, and experiences because varied perspectives help us make better decisions and build better products.**  

  

**KOLA supports approximately 16,000 users across Volvo Group. Our team focuses on smart assistance and intuitive experiences that simplify users’ work and help them complete tasks efficiently.**  

**As Volvo Group accelerates its digital transformation, we have opportunities to apply modern technologies and ways of working in a business-critical global solution. Where useful, we apply approaches such as Lean UX and Design Thinking to understand needs, test ideas, and improve continuously.**


**Skill Requirements**
----------------------


**Essential capabilities**  

**Demonstrated ability to develop and maintain complex web applications using a modern frontend framework such as React or Angular, together with TypeScript.**  

**Automated build, test, and deployment workflows using Azure and GitHub Actions**  

**Ability to design usable, responsive, accessible, and performant interfaces.**  

**Understanding of secure-by-design practices for web applications.**  

**Experience working collaboratively in an agile, cross-functional software team.**  

**Ability to communicate effectively in spoken and written English in an international working environment.**  

**Willingness to share knowledge and contribute across the team’s workload when needed.**  

  

**Additional capabilities that would be valuable**  

**Web Components and styling approaches such as Bootstrap, CSS-in-JS, Styled Components, or Tailwind.**  

**UX practices such as Lean UX and Design Thinking.**  

**Asynchronous programming, microservice architecture, cloud services, or test-automation frameworks.**  

**Backend development, particularly Java and the Spring framework.**  

**Designing and consuming REST APIs.**  

**Application architecture, DevOps, or broader system-development experience.**


**Must Have Skill**
-------------------


Angular,React.js,TypeScript
**Good to Have Skill**
----------------------

title: Senior Software Engineer - Site Tech
description:
**Job Description**  

At H&M Group, technology is more than supporting the business. It's creating better experiences for customers, colleagues, and millions of people around the world.


We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our Global Infrastructure Solution Centre, where you'll help shape the technology that powers thousands of stores, offices, warehouses, and digital workplaces across our global business.


This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of software engineering, automation, infrastructure, cloud, and AI. You'll help us make complex technology simple, scalable, and accessible, enabling development teams across H&M Group to move faster and deliver better experiences.

 **WHAT YOU'LL DO**


As a Senior Software Engineer, you'll be part of a team responsible for building and evolving the platforms, services, and automation that support H&M Group's global physical technology landscape.


You will:

* Design, develop, and maintain software solutions that simplify and automate infrastructure delivery and operations.
* Build integrations between physical edge infrastructure environments and centralized backend services.
* Improve developer experiences through self-service capabilities, automation, and modern engineering practices.
* Contribute to platform capabilities that support stores, warehouses, offices, and edge computing solutions at scale.
* Develop solutions for monitoring, observability, and operational excellence.
* Collaborate closely with architects, engineers, delivery managers, and technology teams across H&M Group.
* Leverage AI-powered development tools while ensuring high-quality, secure, and maintainable software solutions.
* Drive engineering best practices and mentor colleagues through your technical expertise.

 **WHO YOU ARE**


We believe you're a curious and collaborative engineer who enjoys solving complex challenges and turning ideas into scalable solutions.


You likely have:

* Several years of experience working as a Software Engineer in complex technology environments.
* Experience working with observability and monitoring technologies, ideally including OpenTelemetry.
* Strong programming experience, preferably in Python or similar modern languages.
* Hands-on experience with container technologies such as Docker.
* Experience with CI/CD and modern development workflows, including GitHub and GitHub Actions.
* Knowledge of automation, infrastructure-as-code, and platform engineering principles.
* Experience integrating systems, platforms, and APIs across different technology domains.
* An understanding of distributed systems, event-driven architectures, or technologies such as Kafka.
* Experience working with cloud hyperscaler platforms.
* A passion for continuous learning and exploring emerging technologies, including AI-assisted software development.

 **What makes this role exciting**


This is not a traditional software engineering role.


You'll be working in a space where software meets the physical world. From stores and warehouses to offices and edge infrastructure, you'll help create scalable platforms and automation that make technology easier to consume across H&M Group.


You'll have the opportunity to influence how infrastructure and software engineering come together, helping us create seamless developer experiences while supporting a global technology landscape.

 **Who you'll work with**


You'll join a diverse team of engineers, architects, delivery managers, and technology specialists who are passionate about building reliable, scalable, and secure solutions. We value collaboration, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement, and we believe great ideas can come from anywhere.

 **Why you'll love working here**


At H&M Group, we're creating meaningful technology that reaches millions of customers and supports our colleagues every day.


We offer:

* A collaborative and inclusive culture.
* Opportunities to learn, grow, and develop your career.
* Access to modern technologies and large-scale engineering challenges.
* The chance to make a real impact on the future of retail technology.

 **Join us**


If you're excited about software engineering, automation, cloud technologies, and building platforms that enable others to succeed, we'd love to hear from you.


Apply today and help us reimagine the future of technology at H&M Group.

title: Software Engineer
description:
About the Role You love making things work. You're not in love with a specific solution or technology, but rather delivering value to users. At Tandem, Software Engineers are the ones who turn ideas into products that make a real difference for clinicians and patients. You’ll take on whatever stands in the way of our product’s real-world impact, from designing and building new functionality to debugging complex systems, improving integrations, and making sure everything runs smoothly.
  
  

The learnings and abstractions you build along the way will set the foundation for the next generation of the product offering. You’ll see firsthand how the tech you build actually changes how healthcare works, and you’ll become one of the people who truly understand both the technical and operational sides of what we do. It’s a role for builders – people who want to learn fast, ship fast, and see their work make a difference immediately.
  
  

If that sounds like you, we’d love to meet you. What You Will Do Design, build, deploy, and improve software that delivers real value to our users. Debug and solve complex, real-world problems across infrastructure, APIs, data flows, RPA, and configuration. Write clean, pragmatic code to build and extend our systems.
  
  

Collaborate with clinicians, partners, and our internal teams to understand problems, remove blockers, and deliver effective solutions. Shape the next generation of our product through thoughtful engineering and rapid iteration. Continuously identify, automate, and improve painful or inefficient processes so we can scale smarter. What You Bring Deep love for programming and problem-solving.
  
  

Curiosity that borders on obsession - you like understanding why things work (or don’t). A bias toward action - you’d rather get things done than talk about them. Comfort working in ambiguity and high velocity. A mindset that leans toward ownership, creativity, and energy.
  
  

Key nice-to-haves Experience with authentication and authorization RPA experience Any other language skills than a fluency in English is a plus, especially German. Solid experience coding in Python, TypeScript, or C#. Benefits Competitive salary and company stock options. 30 days of paid holiday each year.
  
  

5,000 SEK wellness allowance, plus 6,000 SEK each year for other health-related initiatives. Parental leave top-up for new parents. Private medical insurance. Mental health support through Mindler.
  
  

Pension programme. Regular social and team activities, including off-sites and seasonal events. We review our benefits regularly and may change them from time to time.

title: IT Operations Engineer
description:
**Location:** Mariestad, Sweden Type: Full-time, Permanent Language Requirement: English (Fluent), Swedish (Fluent) Workplace Model: Hybrid - occasional work from home as schedule allows Travel: Up to 15% within Sweden Reporting to: IT Operations Team Leader About the Role We are looking for an IT Operations Engineer to join our Nordic IT Operations team and support our Swedish sites, serving approximately 640 employees across offices and manufacturing facilities. In this role, you will provide first and second line IT support, helping to ensure stable, secure and efficient IT services across the business. You will support end users, maintain IT equipment, contribute to infrastructure improvements, and participate in both local and Nordic IT projects. This is an excellent opportunity for someone early in their IT career who enjoys solving technical challenges, working closely with users, and developing their skills in a modern and international IT environment.
  
  

Principal Responsibilities and Accountabilities End User Support • Provide second and third-line technical support to users. • Troubleshoot hardware, software, and connectivity issues. • Manage user accounts, permissions, and access requests. • Escalate complex issues when required.
  
  

IT Operations • Support infrastructure projects, including network improvements and hardware lifecycle management. • Provide support during IT incidents and service outages. • Install, configure, replace, and maintain IT equipment. • Support IT asset inventory, procurement, and disposal activities.
  
  

* Support requests for vulnerability patching and configuration. Microsoft 365 Administration • Assist with account management within the M365 environment. • Support collaboration and productivity tools. Documentation and Compliance • Create and maintain technical documentation.
* Create and update support procedures and user guides. • Ensure compliance and promote awareness of IT security policies. • Support compliance and audit-related activities. Project Support • Participate in local and Nordic IT projects.
* Assist with testing deployment activities. • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives that enhance IT service delivery. About You We are looking for someone who enjoys helping others and is passionate about technology. You are organised, service-minded and eager to learn.


You communicate effectively with colleagues at all levels and enjoy working collaboratively to solve problems. You have gained at least 1-2 years of experience in IT support, service desk, or a similar technical role, with exposure to Microsoft 365, ticket management systems, and Active Directory. In addition, you take ownership of your work, have a structured approach to troubleshooting and are motivated by delivering reliable and efficient IT support in a fast-paced environment. Whether you have recently started your IT career or already gained some experience in a support role, you are keen to continue growing your technical expertise while contributing to the success of the business.
  
  

You hold a degree, diploma, or equivalent qualification in Information Technology. Desired Skills & Qualifications Knowledge of Windows operating systems. Knowledge of Microsoft 365 applications and services. Experience installing and configuring IT hardware.
  
  

Basic understanding of networking concepts. Familiarity with troubleshooting methodologies. Understanding of incident and request management processes. Experience with ticketing systems.
  
  

Basic awareness of ITIL principles. Experience with Windows Server enviroments, SAP or ERP systems, and VPN/remote access tool knowledge is a plus! Nevertheless, we value curiosity, initiative, and a willingness to learn. Why DS Smith?
  
  

At DS Smith, you'll be part of an international organisation where innovation, sustainability, and customer focus drive everything we do. We are passionate about developing smarter, more sustainable packaging solutions and empowering our people to make a real impact. Here, you'll have the opportunity to grow professionally and work alongside talented colleagues in a collaborative and supportive environment. DS Smith is a leading packaging company operating in 34 countries with approximately 30,000 employees worldwide.
  
  

**To learn more about us, visit:** www.dssmith.com We want our employees to thrive both professionally and personally. That's why we offer a range of benefits that support health, wellbeing, and work-life balance, including private health insurance, dental care, regular health check-ups, subsidised lunch, among other benefits. A Workplace for Everyone At DS Smith, we believe that the best teams are built by people with diverse experiences, perspectives, and strengths. So, if this role feels right for you, but you do not meet every qualification, we still encourage you to apply.
  
  

Your ambition, commitment, and potential can be just as important as meeting every requirement listed in the job advertisement. Application and Further Information The position is a permanent, full-time role and reports to the IT Operations Team Leader. A 6-month probationary period applies. **Working hours:** Monday to Friday, 07:45 to 16:30 (local time) If you have further questions about the role, please contact Justin Hoveland, I&T Infrastructure Manager, at Justin.Hoveland@dssmith.com For additional information or questions regarding the recruitment process, please contact our recruitment team at nordic.recruitment@dssmith.com. Please note that we do not accept applications via email. As part of our recruitment process, we use screening questions as well as logical reasoning and personality assessments to support a fair and objective selection process. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so don't wait to submit yours!
  
  

Please submit your application and CV in English. We look forward to hearing from you soon!

title: Samhällsnyttigt IT-proffs söker: Nätverksspecialist
description:
Umeå universitet är ett av Sveriges största lärosäten med över 41 500 studenter och cirka 4 600 anställda. Vid universitetet finns en mångfald av utbildningar av hög kvalitet och världsledande forskning inom flera vetenskapsområden, och här gjordes den banbrytande upptäckten av gensaxen CRISPR-Cas9 som tilldelats Nobelpriset i kemi. Vid Umeå universitet är allt nära. Våra sammanhållna campus gör det lätt att mötas, samarbeta och utbyta kunskap, något som gynnar en dynamisk och öppen kultur. Den samhällsomvandling och de stora gröna investeringar vi ser i norra Sverige skapar enorma möjligheter och komplexa utmaningar. För Umeå universitet handlar det om att bedriva forskning om – och mitt i – ett samhälle i omvandling. Men också om att leverera utbildningar för regioner som behöver expandera fort och hållbart. Det är helt enkelt här framtiden skapas. Är du intresserad av att veta mer? Läs mer om Umeå universitet som arbetsplats.

**Vill du vara med och stötta högre utbildning och samhällsviktig forskning med hjälp av IT? Nu söker vi en erfaren systemspecialist som vill ha en meningsfull tjänst på en trevlig arbetsplats.**

**Bli en del av ITS**


ITS stöttar högre utbildning och samhällsviktig forskning med hjälp av IT. Vi tycker nämligen att kunskap och fakta bidrar till att göra vårt samhälle bättre. Tillsammans jobbar vi för att forskaren, studenten och läraren - lokalt och nationellt – ska kunna få sitt viktiga arbete gjort.


Vi finns i nyrenoverade lokaler i Kunskapens Hus vid Umeå universitet. Här ställer vi upp för varandra när det krävs och här uppskattar vi olikheter och nya perspektiv. ITS är med våra drygt 200 medarbetare en stor och stabil arbetsgivare som erbjuder många möjlighet till karriärutveckling. Vi arbetar flexibelt och målstyrt i gränsöverskridande team där du möter många trevliga kollegor.

**Ditt uppdrag**


Som nätverkstekniker på ITS arbetar du med ett väl utbyggt nätverk som ständigt utvecklas. Ditt uppdrag innebär drift av nätinfrastrukturen som inkluderar fibernät, switchar, accesspunkter, brandväggar med mera.


Nätinfrastrukturen är baserad på Ciscoprodukter som switchar, accesspunkter, ACI, NGFW, ISE men även Citrix ADC och Bind DNS ingår. Du är ett naturligt bollplank som ser vilka behov som finns och kan hitta lösningar som passar verksamheten. Du arbetar i ett team där det dagliga arbetet och lösningarna förankras och där målet är att ligga steget före.

**Om dig**


Du har en universitets- eller högskoleutbildning inom IT, alternativt relevant YH-utbildning med inriktning mot datakommunikation innehållande kunskapsnivå CCNA och CCNP eller motsvarande.


Du är en lagspelare som känner ansvarskänsla, har god samarbetsförmåga och intresse för ny teknik.


Rollen innebär stort eget ansvar och ett teamorienterat arbetssätt samt krav på god förmåga att uttrycka sig i tal och skrift på både svenska och engelska. Du är en naturlig problemlösare med sinne för automatisering och som snabbt kan sätta dig in i nya system och arkitekturer.


Aktuell och relevant erfarenhet från arbete med förvaltning och utveckling av nätverk inom större organisationer är ett krav, liksom kunskaper inom Cisco:s nätverksprodukter såsom ACI, NFGW, ISE samt från Citrix ADC och BindDNS.


Meriterande är det om du har erfarenhet från Umeå universitets nätverksinfrastruktur.


Stor vikt kommer att läggas vid personliga egenskaper.


Provanställning kan komma att tillämpas och tillträde kan vara från december eller senare beroende på överenskommelse.

**Vi är ITS**


För oss är det viktigt att du delar vårt syfte och våra värderingar samt vill vara en del av vår fortsatta utvecklingsresa. Vi strävar efter en optimal mix av kunskaper och erfarenheter i våra team och tar stor hänsyn till det i våra rekryteringar.


ITS är enheten för IT-stöd och systemutveckling vid Umeå universitet. Vår verksamhet handlar om att skapa samhällsnytta med IT, om att stötta människorna bakom högre utbildning och forskning med utveckling, förvaltning och drift.


Vi erbjuder alla medarbetare:


Friskvårdsbidrag (upp till 3000 kr per år)  

Friskvårdstimme (varje vecka)  

Sjukvårds- och läkemedelsersättning  

Semester upp till sju veckor per år

**Ansök nu**


Välkommen med din ansökan senast den 25 november.


Är du nyfiken på - eller har frågor om tjänsten, hör gärna av dig till Håkan Gustafsson, hakan.gustafsson@umu.se, 070 - 322 98 43.


Umeå universitet vill erbjuda en jämställd och jämlik miljö där öppna samtal mellan människor med olika bakgrund och perspektiv lägger grunden för lärande, skaparkraft och utveckling. Vi välkomnar därför personer med olika bakgrunder och erfarenheter att söka den aktuella anställningen.Till bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag och till dig som är försäljare: Vi undanber oss vänligen men bestämt direktkontakt med bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag samt försäljare av ytterligare jobbannonser.

title: Data Engineer
description:
About the Role We are looking for a Data Engineer to develop, maintain and improve the data infrastructure and backend services supporting our RE: Flex platform. The role involves working with real-time IoT data, cloud infrastructure, databases and data pipelines to ensure reliable data collection, processing, storage and delivery. You will work closely with backend developers, DevOps engineers, machine learning engineers and other teams across the business, operations and finance. Alongside hands-on development, you will contribute to technical improvements, code reviews, troubleshooting, documentation and knowledge sharing.
  
  

Key Responsibilities Data Engineering and Pipelines Develop and maintain Python-based services for collecting and processing data from connected energy devices, including battery systems and meters. Build and improve real-time and batch data pipelines using MQTT, Google Cloud Pub/Sub and other messaging technologies. Integrate data from external APIs, energy market platforms and other relevant data sources. Implement data validation, error handling, retry mechanisms and safe backfilling to improve data quality and reliability.
  
  

Develop and maintain data processing workflows, including aggregation and transformation of time-series data. Backend Development and Cloud Infrastructure Develop and maintain backend APIs and services for accessing real-time and historical platform data. Work with databases and storage solutions such as BigQuery, TimescaleDB, PostgreSQL and MongoDB, depending on application requirements. Develop, deploy and maintain containerised applications using Docker and Kubernetes.
  
  

Contribute to cloud infrastructure improvements, primarily within Google Cloud Platform. Support integrations between data services, backend applications and other platform components. Data Quality, Monitoring and Reliability Monitor data pipelines, database performance and service reliability using tools such as Grafana and cloud monitoring services. Investigate data inconsistencies, missing records, processing failures and other production issues.
  
  

Improve data processing performance, scalability and operational stability. Implement appropriate data quality checks, logging, monitoring and alerting. Support incident investigation, troubleshooting and implementation of technical fixes. Energy Market and Business Data Support data processing and integration for energy market operations, including market prices, schedules, measurements and settlement information.
  
  

Develop and maintain data workflows used for operational reporting, revenue calculations and customer invoicing. Work with market operations, finance and other business teams to understand data requirements and resolve discrepancies. Help ensure data consistency and traceability across relevant systems and integrations. Technical Collaboration and Documentation Participate in technical planning, architecture discussions and code reviews.
  
  

Coordinate with backend, DevOps, machine learning and other engineering teams on data-related implementations. Support onboarding and knowledge sharing with other engineers. Maintain technical documentation, data flow descriptions and operational procedures. Contribute to continuous improvements in development practices, deployment processes and platform reliability.
  
  

Required Qualifications Relevant education in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. At least 5 years of professional experience in data engineering, backend development or a related software engineering role. Strong programming skills in Python and good knowledge of SQL. Experience developing data pipelines, backend services and REST APIs.
  
  

Experience working with relational or NoSQL databases and cloud-based data processing. Familiarity with messaging systems, streaming data or asynchronous processing. Practical experience with Docker and cloud infrastructure. Understanding of software development practices, version control, testing and debugging.
  
  

Good communication skills and the ability to collaborate with technical and non-technical teams. Professional working proficiency in English. Meriting Experience Google Cloud Platform, particularly Pub/Sub, BigQuery and Cloud Storage. MQTT, IoT telemetry or real-time data processing.
  
  

TimescaleDB, PostgreSQL, MongoDB or other time-series and NoSQL databases. Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure automation. Dagster, Airflow or similar data orchestration tools. Monitoring and observability tools such as Grafana and Prometheus.
  
  

Experience with data reconciliation, reporting or invoicing integrations. Knowledge of battery energy storage systems, energy flexibility services or Nordic electricity markets. Experience supporting technical onboarding, documentation or cross-team coordination. What We Offer The opportunity to contribute to Sweden's energy transition through real-world energy technology solutions.
  
  

Hands-on experience working with real-time data, cloud infrastructure and distributed energy systems. A collaborative engineering environment with opportunities to contribute to technical decisions and platform improvements. The opportunity to work across data engineering, backend development and energy market applications.

title: Project Lead
description:
**About Cognizant:**

Cognizant (Nasdaq: CTSH) is an AI Builder and technology services provider, bridging the gap between AI investment and enterprise value by building full-stack AI solutions for our clients. Our deep industry, process and engineering expertise enables us to build an organization’s unique context into technology systems that amplify human potential, drive tangible outcomes and keep global enterprises ahead in a fast-changing world. See how at cognizant.ai or @cognizant.

**About the role**


As a **Project Lead for Store Checkout**, you will play a key role in delivering checkout and point-of-sale (POS) capabilities for new store launches and major retail transformation initiatives. You will be a valued member of our Retail & Consumer Technology team, working closely with Product Owners, Architects, Store Operations, Engineering teams, Vendors, and Business Stakeholders, you will drive the end-to-end delivery of checkout solutions across multiple store opening programs and rollout initiatives. You will be responsible for ensuring that checkout capabilities are implemented safely, on schedule, and in alignment with business objectives and operational requirements.


This is a highly visible role within a large-scale retail expansion and modernization program, requiring strong delivery leadership, stakeholder management, and execution expertise. You will shape delivery plans, manage dependencies across multiple teams, oversee rollout activities, and ensure every new store is equipped with reliable, scalable, and customer-focused checkout solutions. Your ability to balance strategic planning with hands-on project execution will be critical to the successful launch of new retail locations and ongoing transformation efforts.


In this role, you will:

* Project Lead for Store Checkout workstreams in New Store Openings, store rebuilds, relocations, and major refurbishments, ensuring successful deployment of POS, self-checkout, payment solutions, and supporting store technology in alignment with global standards, project timelines, budgets, and operational readiness requirements.
* Lead and coordinate end-to-end delivery of Store Checkout initiatives across multiple product teams.
* Own scope, schedule, quality, and release readiness for committed SOW and change request deliverables.
* Coordinate cross-functional teams including Product, Engineering, Store Operations and external vendors.
* Plan and oversee phased store rollouts, including pilots, cutover windows, and rollback readiness.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives and identify opportunities for process optimization.
* Ensure operational readiness before ownership transfer, including validated SOPs, runbooks, monitoring, and L1/L2 support handover.
* Partner with client stakeholders, architects, payments, retail platform, and store infrastructure teams to manage dependencies.
* Run operational and tactical governance, including status reporting, risk and issue management, and escalation.

**Work Model**


We believe hybrid work is the way forward as we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role’s business requirements, this is a hybrid position. Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work-life balance through our various wellbeing programs.


The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you’re engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured; we will always be clear about role expectations.

**What You Must Have to Be Considered**

* 8+ years of experience in software delivery, with 3+ years leading multi-team programs or projects.
* Demonstrated experience delivering retail technology, ideally POS, checkout, payments, or store systems.
* Strong understanding of Agile at scale (SAFe or similar), including PI planning and cross-team dependency management.
* Proven experience managing SOW/CR-based commercials, budgets, and margin targets.
* Familiarity with observability and operations tooling such as Dynatrace, Splunk, Prometheus, and Grafana.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and leadership skills.
* Experience coordinating cross-functional teams in multi-vendor, hybrid, and distributed delivery environments.

**These Will Help You Stand Out**

* Familiarity with in-store rollout logistics and change management.
* Experience with near-shore or hybrid delivery models.
* Knowledge of retail operations, store support models, and incident management.
* Experience leading programs within retail, e-commerce, or omnichannel environments.
* PSM, SAFe, or equivalent certification.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience within complex enterprise transformation programs.

title: Senior IT- eller Cybersäkerhetskonsult till Dizparc Secured
description:
Vi är Dizparc Secured — ett specialistbolag inom cybersäkerhet. Vårt mål är att göra digital säkerhet enkel och tillgänglig för alla verksamheter, oavsett storlek eller mognadsgrad. Vi hjälper våra kunder att förstå, prioritera och stärka sin cybersäkerhet genom ett brett spektrum av rådgivande och tekniska tjänster. Med fokus på kvalitet och långsiktighet skapar vi förutsättningar för att minska digitala affärsrisker, skydda kritiska tillgångar och ge kunderna trygghet i sin fortsatta digitala utveckling.
  
  

Vårt team består av engagerade specialister som kombinerar strategiskt tänkande med praktisk kunskap. Vi värdesätter nyfikenhet, problemlösning och en kultur där alla får möjlighet att bidra, utvecklas och växa tillsammans. Oavsett hur långt en organisation har kommit i sitt säkerhetsarbete finns vi här för att hjälpa dem ta nästa steg — med trygghet, tydlighet och ett genuint engagemang. Vill du vara med och utveckla vårt CISO Office?
  
  

Tycker du att cybersäkerhet är bland det mest intressanta som händer inom IT just nu? Du kanske arbetar som konsult, arkitekt, IT-chef eller specialist. Oavsett titel har du byggt upp en gedigen teknisk förståelse och märker att allt fler av de frågor du arbetar med handlar om säkerhet, risk och motståndskraft. Nu söker du kanske ett sammanhang där cybersäkerhet inte bara är en del av uppdraget, utan själva kärnan.
  
  

Där du får kombinera teknik, rådgivning och kunddialog tillsammans med kollegor som delar samma intresse. Om du känner igen dig i det, tror vi att du kommer trivas hos oss. Om Dizparc Vi är ett cybersäkerhetsbolag med ett tydligt uppdrag: att göra professionell säkerhet tillgänglig för svenska verksamheter som inte har resurser för en egen säkerhetsorganisation men som har precis lika mycket att förlora som de stora. Kärnan i det vi gör är vårt CISO Office.
  
  

Ett externt team som ger kunder tillgång till en hel cybersäkerhetsavdelnings erfarenhet och struktur. Vi arbetar med styrning, riskhantering, teknisk rådgivning, testning och utbildning som ett sammanhållet erbjudande. Nu växer vi och vi vill ha med oss rätt person på den resan. Rollen Vi tror inte på att låsa fast rollen i en specifik profil.
  
  

Rollen formas till stor del utifrån din erfarenhet och dina styrkor. Du kan idag arbeta som exempelvis senior konsult, lösningsarkitekt, IT-chef, säkerhetsspecialist eller i en annan rådgivande roll där teknik, verksamhet och kunddialog möts. Gemensamt är att du vill arbeta närmare cybersäkerhet och hjälpa kunder att omsätta komplexa frågor till konkreta lösningar. Hos oss kan dina uppdrag exempelvis handla om: strategisk rådgivning inom cybersäkerhet informationssäkerhet och compliance säkerhetsarkitektur risk- och mognadsanalyser säkerhetsutbildningar teknisk rådgivning inom IT- och säkerhetsområdet Vad vi faktiskt söker Du har sannolikt flera års erfarenhet från en senior roll inom IT, infrastruktur, arkitektur eller cybersäkerhet.
  
  

Du är van att ta ansvar för kundrelationer, kommunicera med både tekniker och beslutsfattare och känner dig trygg i att driva uppdrag framåt. Har du dessutom erfarenhet av exempelvis NIS2, ISO 27001, NIST CSF, OT-säkerhet, penetrationstestning eller andra säkerhetsområden är det starkt meriterande. För oss är erfarenheten viktig, men ännu viktigare är inställningen. Drivet.
  
  

Nyfikenheten. Viljan att fortsätta utvecklas och bidra till något större. Cybersäkerhetslandskapet förändras snabbt. Hos oss omger du dig med folk som lever i det varje dag.
  
  

Det är vår miljö. Det enda vi förväntar oss är att du tar tillvara på den. Vad vi erbjuder Hos Dizparc Secured blir du en del av ett specialistbolag där cybersäkerhet står i centrum. Du får arbeta tillsammans med erfarna kollegor i ett prestigelöst team med djup kompetens och höga ambitioner.
  
  

Som ett mindre specialistbolag har vi korta beslutsvägar och stora möjligheter att påverka, både den egna rollen och hur vi utvecklar vårt erbjudande framåt. Vi tror på frihet under ansvar och att riktigt bra konsulter fortsätter utvecklas genom hela karriären. Därför avsätter vi tid för utbildning, certifieringar och kompetensutveckling som en naturlig del av arbetet – inte något som sker på fritiden. Här får du möjlighet att arbeta nära kunder, utvecklas inom cybersäkerhet och vara med och bygga något långsiktigt.
  
  

Hittar du inte dig själv i varje punkt ovan, men känner att rollen och miljön passar dig? Hör gärna av dig ändå. Vi lägger större vikt vid potential, driv och rätt inställning än att du ska bocka av varje rad i en kravprofil. Praktiskt Placering: Karlstad.
  
  

**Start:** Enligt överenskommelse. Anställningsform: Tillsvidareanställning. I denna rekrytering samarbetar Dizparc Secured med Qtym. Vi går igenom ansökningar löpande, vilket innebär att rollen kan tillsättas före sista ansökningsdatum.
  
  

Vi tar endast emot ansökningar via ansökningsformuläret. Har du frågor om rollen är du varmt välkommen att kontakta ansvarig rekryterare.

title: Senior Software Engineer - Payments
description:
We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our Payments team in Stockholm. We're a small team that owns everything that happens when someone pays Epidemic Sound: checkout, subscriptions, invoicing, refunds, tax, and payment provider integrations happens through systems we build and run. We work in short iterations where our changes bring immediate customer value. Our main initiative is a new purchase platform in Go: a greenfield subscription domain, built alongside today's system, including a seamless migration of live paying customers onto our new system.
  
  

You'll help set and implement this technical direction. We’re a small and collaborative team that owns services end to end, from domain model to Terraform, on-call included. You'll work closely with Product, Finance, and the web teams whose checkout journeys sit on our APIs. AI is part of our daily toolchain, which puts more weight on judgement: we read as much code as we write.
  
  

Your key responsibilities include Own payment and subscription services end to end: design, build, deploy and monitor them. Build the next generation of our purchase platform in Go, and move live subscriptions onto it safely. Build and maintain our payment provider integrations, including the compliance-heavy parts like 3DS and SCA. Work in the customer-facing purchase flow in our web codebase (TypeScript) when needed.
  
  

Requirements Several years building and running backend services in production, ideally in a space where correctness mattered more than shipping speed. Strong in Go or Python, and happy to get productive in the other. Our services are built in both. Good in SQL and relational data modelling.
  
  

We use Postgres. Cloud experience, preferably Google Cloud, and comfortable owning your own infrastructure (Kubernetes, Helm, Terraform). Enough TypeScript and React to make changes in a shared frontend codebase, or a real interest in picking it up. Experience with payments, or a clear interest in it: subscriptions, billing, provider integrations, reconciliation, etc.
  
  

It would also be music to our ears if you have Migrated a billing or payment platform with live customers on it. Worked with PSPs, card networks, 3DS and SCA, or inside PCI scope. Experience building event-driven services using Pub/Sub or a comparable messaging system. Practical experience applying AI coding agents in production, and sound judgement about when to rely on them.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Etraveli Group is a leading global flight technology provider, specializing in flight sales and offering flight content delivery and fintech products. We are here to solve complexity, by connecting millions of flights and travelers across the globe, from search and selection to trip and beyond.


We partner with major global platforms such as Booking.com, Google Flights, Skyscanner, and Kayak, providing seamless flight booking and related services. Our B2B portfolio includes Precision, our specialist in travel fintech; Tripstack, our B2B Flights as a Service Provider and world leader in virtual interlining, serving as the gateway to Etraveli Group’s flight content and fulfillment services; Wenrix, the AI Infrastructure for profitable growth in air; and Flygresor.se, Sweden’s leading flight comparison site. We also operate our own online travel agency brands including Gotogate, Mytrip, and Flightnetwork.


Every day we strive to make the world smaller for our customers and bigger for our people. Our diverse team of more than 3200 passionate professionals is what makes us the industry’s tech wonder and the best in the world at what we do.


Major offices in Sweden (HQ), Greece, India, Canada, Israel, Poland, UK, and Uruguay.

### **The Role**


Etraveli Group relies on a massive scale of data to drive decision-making, analytics, and machine learning across Finance, Customer Service, Sales, and Data Science. To support our ambitious growth targets and the ongoing transformation of our data platform, we are looking for a skilled Data Engineer to serve as a pivotal technical engine in our Data Platform team.


You will work closely with our business stakeholders, analysts and data scientists defining data solutions and implementing data products that solve their needs. You will bridge the gap between raw, distributed data sources and high-performing data products, bringing critical data into our lakehouse platform and preparing it for diverse users. You will support the growth of our modern, scalable data warehouse solutions, ensuring our data pipelines are reliable, secure and deeply integrated into our tech ecosystem.


This is not a purely isolated technical role. The right person can understand underlying business needs – from pricing and conversion to revenue optimization – and answer questions on feasibility by selecting the right industry-leading frameworks, ETL patterns and orchestration tools. You will build solutions that don't just look conceptually good, but actually deliver robust data quality and solve high-stakes complexities within Etraveli.


The role will be based in Gothenburg.

### **Main tasks**

* Design, develop, and maintain robust batch and streaming pipelines tailored to business intelligence, machine learning and other stakeholders needs.
* Interpret, analyse and ingest data from a variety of cloud and on-premise source systems into our expanding data lakehouse platform.
* Evaluate, integrate, and configure industry-leading frameworks and tooling for our Data Engineering platform, prioritizing scalability, optimization/performance and maintainability.
* Define and enforce rigorous data quality standards, implementing relevant monitoring and alerting solutions to ensure high data integrity.
* Work closely with ML Engineers, core backend developers, DBAs, and business stakeholders to prioritize information needs, create synergies and optimize existing data pipelines.
* Ensure high-performance data processing and query execution by applying techniques like indexing, partitioning, caching and efficient data modeling.
* Champion technical excellence by promoting best practices in data engineering, sharing status updates, and contributing to a culture of continuous learning within the team.

### **Requirements**

* 5+ years of experience in data engineering, data warehousing or a comparable technical role
* Strong foundation in data warehousing concepts (Star and Snowflake schemas, Slowly Changing Dimensions, Incremental Loads) and translating business requirements into optimal data models
* Proven hands-on experience building and testing batch and streaming pipelines. Familiarity with distributed query engines and processing tools (Spark, dbt, Dremio/Trino, Databricks) as well as orchestration (Airflow)
* Proficiency in SQL and multiple scripting/programming languages such as Python, Scala and Bash.
* Deep understanding of data lakehouse architectures, utilizing object storage (S3/Ceph), modern table formats (Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake for ACID transactions/time-travel) and data formats (Parquet, Avro, JSON, CSV).
* Experience with distributed messaging systems (Kafka) and Change Data Capture (CDC) tools (Debezium, Flink CDC, Kafka Connect).
* Comfortable working with Linux, Docker and Kubernetes. Experience with CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, Artifactory) and monitoring/alerting stacks (Grafana, Kibana). Note: Experience with secrets management (Vault) is a strong merit.

### **Benefits**


At the Etraveli Group Gothenburg office, you will be part of +200 people, all with different cutting-edge skills and personalities. Our shared ambition, passion, and strong work ethic are what drive us toward the same goals. This foundation allows us to value our individual differences, which we believe are precisely what make us a strong team. With us you can enjoy:

* Our office is located in Merkurhuset in Gothenburg, a few steps away from public transport and lunch restaurants.
* We work on a hybrid-model where you can choose to work two days from home and you have two weeks per year that you can choose to work from a remote location
* We love gaming and after work activities.
* We know the value of personal development and continuous training.
* Hackathons and Dev Weeks - We believe in promoting creativity and trying new things.
* Healthcare allowance – Each employee receives a maximum allowable amount each year according to the Swedish Tax Agency to spend on health-promoting activities such as a gym card, massage etc.
* Pension and health insurance – Through partners we offer a comprehensive pension and health insurance so that you can get help quickly in case of an accident.
* Daily breakfast – To kick the day off just right, breakfast is available at the office every morning.

***As part of this recruitment process, we will be conducting background checks. You will be able to read more information and give your consent to this process in the application form.***

##### **Diversity disclaimer**

*At Etraveli Group we value diversity; we pride ourselves on being a company represented by people of all different backgrounds.* *During hiring, we are committed to ensure equality and promote diversity in the workplace at every selection stage. title: OT Cyber Security Engineer
description:
OT Cyber Security Engineer – Substation Automation Key Responsibilities: 1. Security Audits Identify vulnerabilities in IEC 61850-based communication, RTUs, IEDs, and SCADA networks. Assist to perform penetration testing and red teaming for substation control environments. Perform technical audits of SCADA devices and networks, and any other connected networks, to identify security concerns.
  
  

Evaluate security compliance with NERC CIP, IEC 62443, and IEEE standards. Support Global Projects by adapting HVDC Cyber security for SCADA & HMI. 2. Security Implementation & Architecture Design and implement segmented network architectures for substations (firewalls, DMZs, VLANs).
  
  

Secure IEC 61850 protocols (GOOSE, MMS, SMV) to prevent cyber-attacks. Deploy Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS), Security Information and Event Management (SIEM), and Endpoint Protection for OT environments. Harden SCADA servers, HMIs, and substation gateways against cyber threats. Develop architecture & functional descriptions for Functions / Solutions for future HVDC in cyber security technologies.
  
  

Evaluate and strengthen the security of any connections to the SCADA network. Monitor and Validate third party security patches to ensure that reliability of the system is maintained. Implement the security features provided by device and system vendors. 3.
  
  

Incident Response & Threat Management Develop and test Incident Response Plans (IRP) for cyber events in substations. Monitor threat intelligence and assess the impact of cyber threats on energy transmission systems. Assist in forensic investigations of cybersecurity incidents in substations. Implement Zero Trust Architecture (ZTA) and role-based access control (RBAC) in substation networks.
  
  

4. Compliance & Regulatory Alignment Ensure compliance with NERC CIP (Critical Infrastructure Protection) for bulk electric systems. Align cybersecurity controls with IEC 62443, ISO 27001, and IEEE 1686. Assist in audit preparation and regulatory reporting for utilities and power grid operators.
  
  

5. Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement Work with utility companies, regulators, and vendors to enhance grid cybersecurity. Participate in industry working groups (NERC, IEEE, ISA, EPRI) to influence cybersecurity standards. Support projects in resolving the issues related to Cyber security Functions.
  
  

**Required Skills :** Technical Skills Deep understanding of substation automation (IEC 61850, DNP3, Modbus, MMS, GOOSE messaging). SCADA, RTU, IED, and EMS security expertise. Network security (firewalls, IDS/IPS, VPNs, NAC) in OT environments. Vulnerability assessment and penetration testing of OT/ICS systems.
  
  

Experience with SIEM, log management, and anomaly detection tools.
