title: Receptionist Scandic Anglais, deltid 50%
description:
Ansök nu
* Stockholm
* Arbete på plats
**Arbetsuppgifter**
-------------------


**Scandic Anglais är hotellet som ligger mitt i stadspulsen på Stureplan!**


Scandic Anglais ligger mitt i centrala Stockholm, intill det pulserande Stureplan och den grönskande Humlegården. I kvarteren runt hotellet finns Stockholms bästa shoppingstråk och centrum av Stockholms uteliv. Hos oss kan gäster njuta av Stureplanspulsen i vår populära Bar Anglais, där laptopjobb varvas med klassiska barrätter och stimmiga afterworks. Under sommaren kan våra gäster även besöka vår takbar med utsikt över takåsarna och Humlegårdens grönska.


Kännetecknande för arbetet på Scandic Anglais är den familjära stämningen och passionen för god service. Tillsammans strävar vi efter att fortsatt vara en destination för såväl Stockholmare och tillresande samt att ge våra gäster service i absolut toppklass. Så nu söker vi dig som tillsammans med oss vill ge våra gäster service utöver det vanliga!


**Nu söker vi en Receptionist till Scandic Anglais.**


Oavsett varför gästen kommer till oss är det få saker som är så uppskattade som ett vänligt ansikte som hälsar välkommen. Du agerar värd tillsammans med övriga teamet på hotellet och skapar en gästupplevelse i världsklass.


Hos oss får du ta ett stort eget ansvar för att ta de beslut som krävs för att göra gästen nöjd och teamen utvecklar och förbättrar arbetssätt och service i takt med att omvärlden förändras. Vi är nämligen övertygade om att det är när du får utvecklas och bidra med all din kompetens och erfarenhet som vi överträffar gästens förväntningar. På köpet får vi kul på jobbet!


Så ta med dig dina erfarenheter, ditt engagemang och ditt sätt att tänka till oss – och bidra till en kultur där vi bryr oss på riktigt: om varandra, våra gäster och vår planet. Välkommen till Scandic!


**Vad är innebär rollen?**


Du som arbetar i receptionen är ansvarig för att våra gäster får service i världsklass. Du är spindeln i nätet som ser till att gästen alltid är i fokus. Du är den som går igenom ankomstlistan och lägger tid på detaljerna. Ser till att gästens önskemål uppfylls. Du har alltid ett leende på läpparna och en kreativ lösning i bakfickan. Du löser det mesta och är en stjärna på att vända en missnöjd gäst till en nöjd gäst. Din arbetsplats är vår lobby. För det är där du möter flest gäster. I ansvarsområdet ingår även administrativt arbete, säkerhetsarbete och arbete med försäljning.


Arbetet i receptionen innebär att checka in och ut hotellets gäster, hälsa välkommen och ge gästen den information den behöver om sin vistelse. Du hanterar bokningar i systemet Opera Cloud och hanterar administrativa uppgifter runt gäster och säkerhet. Allt arbete sker med gästnöjdhet och försäljning i fokus.


Hotellet har öppet dygnet runt och det är därför viktigt att du trivs med att arbeta i skift (förmiddagar, eftermiddagar och helger).


**Vem är du?**


För att passa i rollen tror vi att du har en väl utvecklad social förmåga och är kapabel att hantera att det händer många olika saker samtidigt. Det är mycket viktigt att du kan förmedla ett gott värdskap till hotellets gäster.


Du har också vana och kunskap i att arbeta med dator som arbetsredskap.


Eftersom arbetet till stor del består av att kommunicera med gäster är goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska en förutsättning. Talar du ytterligare ett språk är det meriterande.


Allra viktigast är dock dina personliga egenskaper och din inställning. För att passa i rollen behöver du vara en lyhörd och prestigelös lagspelare som tar ett stort ansvar för dina arbetsuppgifter och helhetsresultatet.


**Information om tjänsten**


Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning på deltid.


Vi tar enbart emot ansökningar via vår hemsida. Alla ansökningar kommer att behandlas löpande och tjänsten kan tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag, varför vi ber dig att ansöka så snart som möjligt. I denna rekrytering använder vi oss av ett enklare test om service vid urvalet.


Vi ser fram emot att välkomna dig till oss på Scandic!


Ps. på vår hemsida kan du läsa mer om vår kultur, vad tjänsten innebär och om våra förmåner!

title: Account Executive, Strategic Deals - Attribute™, EMEA
description:
**Account Executive, Strategic Deals - Attribute™**


**Location**  

This is a **fully remote** opportunity based out of any of the following with travel as needed: UK, Ireland, Netherlands, Sweden, Estonia.


**Who We Are**  

Become part of the team behind **Attribute™**. Following our recent acquisition, we're bringing together visionary engineers and go-to-market leaders to disrupt cloud management with real-time, tagless cost visibility across cloud and AI workloads. As an Account Executive focused on Strategic Deals, you'll join a founding GTM movement inside an established market leader trusted by over 4,500 global customers, unlocking high-impact opportunities through top-tier strategic partnerships.



DoiT empowers cloud-native organizations to scale faster and innovate with confidence. By combining our Cloud Intelligence technology with Forward Deployed Engineers and deep specialization across AWS, Google Cloud, and Azure, we help tech-forward companies navigate their toughest infrastructure and cost governance challenges end to end.


**The Opportunity**  

As an Account Executive, Strategic Deals for **Attribute™**, you will be at the forefront of building a brand-new region from scratch and introducing a groundbreaking solution to a fundamental business problem in modern FinOps. You will work on Strategic Deals, leveraging strategic partnerships with AWS, OpenAI, Top Private Equity firms, and our global current install base. A strong focus will be placed on co-selling and unlocking strategic deal opportunities with AWS, ISVs, and channel partners. Traditional cloud cost allocation methods rely heavily on static tagging—an approach that becomes obsolete in modern, shared cloud and AI infrastructure. When multi-tenant clusters, shared GPUs, microservices, and dynamic AI workloads dominate, organizations face severe blind spots: they cannot accurately determine the true cost-to-serve for specific applications, autonomous agents, or business teams, making it impossible to calculate true gross margins at a granular customer level.



Attribute™ solves this by taking a completely different approach. Leveraging runtime eBPF technology, Attribute™ captures real-time network traffic signals and kernel-level observability without requiring engineering teams to manually tag or instrument code. By analyzing actual runtime consumption across CPU, GPU, memory, network, and AI model API requests, it provides accurate total cost of ownership (TCO) and unit economics based on real usage. Organizations finally get precise cost governance and gross margin visibility across complex cloud and AI environments with zero developer overhead.



As an Account Executive building this region from scratch, you will establish a high-potential greenfield territory. You will drive sales end-to-end with a heavy emphasis on net-new logo acquisition, defining the regional go-to-market strategy and creating the foundational customer success stories that define this category.



You will own full-cycle deal execution across Startup, Digital Native, and Enterprise segments—prospecting new accounts, running compelling solution pitches, navigating complex technical evaluations alongside engineering partners, and closing strategic partnerships end to end.



You'll have the rest of the Cloud Intelligence portfolio behind you: 4,500 customers, AWS/Google Cloud/Azure partnerships, and Forward Deployed Engineers who solve problems other vendors walk away from. But the product you'll carry every day is Attribute™, and the market is only just learning it exists. That's the opportunity.



Expect to travel 10–15% of the time to meet customers, engage with hyperscale teams, and show up at industry events that matter.


**Responsibilities**


* Own the full sales cycle from first conversation to closed deal, consistently hitting and exceeding quota and pipeline targets
* Build a high-volume pipeline and establish the region from scratch with a hunter mindset, driving outbound prospecting and net-new logo acquisition across EMEA
* Build the first wave of reference customers and case studies the rest of the GTM org will run on
* Develop and execute a regional strategy that identifies high-growth opportunities and untapped markets across EMEA
* Build deep, mutually valuable relationships with AWS Sales Leaders and Partner Managers to co-sell and expand market share
* Partner with Forward Deployed Engineers and Solutions Architects to solve the toughest technical challenges prospects face
* Maintain rigorous forecast accuracy in Salesforce and ensure every proposal reflects the quality of what we actually deliver
* Guide customers from initial curiosity through contract execution, setting them up for a world-class onboarding experience
* Feed real customer signal back to product and marketing every week — in a founding team, that loop is the job
* Generate your own pipeline through prospecting, networking, and creative outreach — not just working what's handed to you


**Qualifications**


* Proven track record of full-cycle B2B SaaS sales experience with a strong emphasis on net-new logo acquisition and building a regional territory from scratch
* A track record of selling cloud services and understanding how consumption-based models work
* Hunting mentality: demonstrated drive to self-generate pipeline, prospect into target accounts, and close new business independently
* Experience selling to platform engineering / DevOps teams.
* Comfort selling something new — you've sold a product before there was a Gartner quadrant for it, and you preferred it that way
* Technical curiosity: you understand the cloud computing market and can hold your own in conversations about AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure products and architecture
* Genuine interest in FinOps and how engineering organisations actually consume the cloud — you don't need to be a practitioner, but you need to care
* Ability to build influential relationships across matrixed organisations and turn professional networks into real partnerships
* "Roll up your sleeves" attitude that pervades both sales and business development activities
* Prior experience at AWS, ISVs, or in strategic partnerships is a big plus


**Are You a Doer?**  

Be your truest self. Work on your terms. Make a difference.



We are home to a global team of incredible talent who work remotely and have the flexibility to have a schedule that balances your work and home life. We embrace and support leveling up your skills professionally and personally.



What does being a Do'er mean? We're all about being entrepreneurial, pursuing knowledge, and having fun! Click here to learn more about our Life at DoiT.



Sounds too good to be true? Check out our Glassdoor reviews.



We thought so too, but we're here and happy we hit that 'apply' button.



Full-time employee benefits include:


* Unlimited PTO
* Flexible Working Options
* Health Insurance
* Parental Leave
* Employee Stock Option Plan
* Home Office Allowance
* Professional Development Stipend
* Peer Recognition Program


**Many Doers, One Team**  

DoiT unites as Many Do'ers, One Team, where diversity is more than a goal — it's our strength. We actively cultivate an inclusive, equitable workplace, recognizing that each unique perspective enhances our innovation. By celebrating differences, we create an environment where every individual feels valued, contributing to our collective success.

title: Financial Analyst & Digital Transformation Specialist
description:
**A Snapshot of Your Day**  

Join our dynamic global Business Controlling team and help shape the future of Finance through automation, data visualization and applied AI.


You will collaborate closely with Finance Heads across project and factory organizations, with a particular focus on our operations in Sweden.


You will transform complex data into actionable insights, streamline financial processes and identify opportunities where Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Agents and other approved AI solutions can improve quality, speed and decision-making.


This is an opportunity to combine financial expertise, business understanding and modern technology to create smarter and more efficient ways of working.

**How You’ll Make an Impact**

* Lead the development of automated Finance processes, analytical solutions and data-visualization tools.
* Identify and develop relevant applications of Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Agents and approved AI tools within Finance.
* Translate business requirements into practical digital and AI-supported solutions.
* Collaborate with the global Business Controlling team, with particular focus on the Sweden site.
* Partner with Finance Heads in project and factory organizations to provide strategic business insights.
* Improve data quality, reporting efficiency, documentation and knowledge sharing.
* Support responsible adoption of AI, including appropriate governance, access controls and human review.
* Champion continuous improvement, innovation and scalable solutions within financial operations.

 **What You Bring**

* Higher university education, within finance, controlling, data or other relevant field.
* At least 3-5 years of experience within a Finance organization as a controlling or finance professional, combined with strong data-analysis skills.
* Proven experience in process automation, business intelligence or data visualization.
* Practical knowledge of Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Agents, generative AI or comparable AI-supported business tools.
* An understanding of how AI can be applied responsibly to reporting, analysis, process support and knowledge management.
* Experience with tools such as Power BI, Alteryx, SAP Analytics Cloud, Power Automate, Copilot Studio or similar platforms.
* Strong communication skills in English; Swedish is beneficial.

  

Beneficial requirements, but not a must:

* Experience from a large manufacturing, industrial or engineering company.
* Experience with Tableau is considered an advantage but is not required.

  

Our ideal candidate can turn complex financial and operational data into clear business insights, takes a proactive approach to solving problems and improving ways of working, and collaborates effectively with stakeholders across functions, locations, and seniority levels.

 **About the Team**  

You will join a collaborative and forward-looking Business Controlling team  

that works with Finance leaders across multiple project and factory organizations.


The team focuses on financial excellence, automation, data-driven decision-making and responsible use of AI. Based in Sweden, the role works closely with international colleagues to develop reusable solutions and support Siemens Energy’s wider digital transformation.

 **Who is Siemens Energy?**


At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.


Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.


Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

**Our Commitment to Diversity**  

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

 **Application**  

Don’t hesitate – apply via https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/en\_US/jobs , id nr 305922 no later than 2026-11-18.


Ongoing selection is applied, the role might be filled before last application date.


We refrain from all contact with staffing and recruitment companies, or advertising brokers.

  

Location: Finspång

Sveriges Ingenjörer & SACO, asi.se@siemens-energy.com

title: Senior Technical Lead
description:
**Job Summary**
---------------



VOLVO IT  

"VOLGJP000043497 Data Platform Lead (Developer Platform Engineer Principal) to Digital Services


The Position


We are looking for a Data Platform Lead to join our Data, Analytics & AI Organization at Digital Services within Digital Technology and Operations. You will work together with Data Scientists, ML Engineers, Data Analysts, Data Engineers and Platform Engineers to lead the transition into a data driven culture, where Data, Analytics & AI/ML are an integral part of our services and internal processes. By having the responsibility all the way from raw data to actionable insights, we are at the forefront of creating value from Volvo Group’s customers’ 1.8 million connected assets.

  

The Role


As a Data Platform Lead, you are a key player in ensuring the technical integrity, scalability, and security of our core data platform. You will architect and implement the technical foundations that allow us to scale our data-driven services and future proof our deliveries by owning the ""how"" of our platform.


You will also be responsible for day-to-day operations of the platform together with our platform engineers, such as managing access, auditing usage, empowering our federated development teams and developing efficient maintenance processes.


Your key responsibilities will include:


Infrastructure as code codebase owner: Having ownership of our infrastructure as code setup built in Terraform, ensuring best practices for lifecycle management and disaster recovery  

Lakehouse & Infrastructure Design: Owning the architecture of our Databricks environment and AWS infrastructure, ensuring secure, efficient, and cost-effective cloud resource utilization.  

Integration & Delivery: Designing the integration patterns—from batch processing to fast APIs and event-driven streams—that bridge our analytical platform with high-concurrency telematics applications.


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


Technical Governance & Access: Designing the unified access control framework and translating business-level privacy policies into practical data masking and security measures.  

Structure & Automation: Establishing the overarching structural naming conventions and automated checks that enforce data contracts without creating bottlenecks for our domain teams.  

Your Profile


We believe you are a creative and entrepreneurial problem-solver that together with others can define the best practice architecture for end-to-end data solutions. You enjoy working in a team and can guide data professionals in navigating complex technical landscapes, ensuring quality, performance optimization, and scalable delivery. You are also keen on staying at the forefront of technology and can help guide the organization in tool selection and infrastructure setup.


When it comes to technology, you have solid experience designing and deploying large-scale data platforms in a cloud environment. You are proficient in modern data architecture principles and have hands-on expertise with Databricks, Spark, Python, and SQL. We work in a hybrid cloud environment with a strong focus on AWS, so experience designing secure cloud infrastructure, serving layers, and infrastructure-as-code is essential.


As an individual, we think you are communicative, self-driven, innovative, and like to push boundaries together with your team. And as we strive to have fun at work, humor is appreciated."

-------------------


Data Analytics,Databricks

----------------------

title: Key Account Manager – Professional Services
description:
Frends is a Nordic iPaaS platform used by more than 6,000 customers across 16 countries. We connect systems, automate workflows and manage APIs — and behind every platform sits something that matters just as much: the integration projects that turn it into real business outcomes, and the ongoing partnership, service commitments and SLAs that follow.


Recognised for the fourth consecutive year in the Gartner® Magic Quadrant™, with G2 awards and a 4.7/5 rating on Gartner Peer Insights.


Professional Services is a growing part of our business, and we're strengthening our team in Sweden.


We're looking for a **Key Account Manager – Professional Services** — someone who can focus entirely on growing the services business in Sweden.


### **What you´ll do**


**In this role you will focus** **on Frends professional services (PS):** the integration projects that turn our platform into real business outcomes, and the ongoing partnership, service commitments and SLAs that follow.


**This is not a prospecting role.** Our Account Executives (AEs) bring the opportunities — you step in where a PS/integration project is the right next step, and you own the scoping, pricing and closing of that project together with the team. Alongside this, you carry your own portfolio of customers across the private and public segments. You will be working closely with our AEs, Solution Architects and our Professional Services organisation.


* **Build project proposals** – Translate a customer problem into a scoped, priced delivery plan with internal stakeholders, and sell the value of the delivered project.
* **Build the relationships** – Beyond the project: the ongoing partnership, service commitments and SLAs that keep customers with Frends. This includes CIOs, IT leaders and the technical stakeholders who decide how integration gets done.
* **Manage a defined portfolio** – Maintain relationships and find new PS opportunities within existing accounts.
* **Lead project steering** – Participate in customer steering meetings and support delivery leadership together with our Professional Services organisation.
* **Team-sell** – Work with the PS delivery teams so what we promise is what we deliver.
* **Own the numbers** – Take responsibility for customer revenue and profitability within your accounts.

### **You won't do this alone**


You'll lead the commercial conversation, but you'll scope and price every engagement together with our Professional Services delivery organisation and internal stakeholders. This role is about owning the customer relationship and the commercial outcome — not about being the only person in the room who can build the numbers.


### **What you bring**


* **A track record of selling complex technical projects or services** – integration, data, ERP, cloud or similar. You've scoped, priced and closed engagements, not just licences.
* **Project proposal skills** – you understand how to size and price a delivery project together with the team and present a compelling business case.
* **Strong Communication & Stakeholder Skills** – You can engage technical and business stakeholders (CIOs, IT managers, project sponsors) and collaborate effectively across internal teams.

**Logistics:** The role requires fluency in written and spoken Swedish and English, as well as living in Sweden with a valid work permit. We support a hybrid work model, but we also prefer you visiting our Stockholm office to ensure smooth collaboration and team spirit.


**Travelling** is required to meet the team, internal stakeholders, customers, and to attend key industry events. Our Professional Services members are currently located in Sweden and Finland, and our sales kick-offs are held in Finland twice a year. This means you will also have opportunities to visit Finland and our Frends headquarters.


### **Why Frends**


* **Work Flexibly** – A hybrid work model that adapts to your life.
* **Visible Impact** – Your work directly shapes how Swedish organisations integrate and automate.
* **"Get Things Done" Mentality:** We value outcomes over corporate politics or endless approval chains — and we have a real mandate to make good deals happen.
* **Join an Established Team, not starting from zero:** You'll work alongside KAMs, CSMs, AEs, Solution Engineers and the professional services organisation.
* **Team selling, not lone selling** – You'll have architects and delivery colleagues beside you.
* **Nordic Leader, Global Challenger** – Join one of the leading Nordic integration technology organisations and help us win as the leading European alternative.
* **Competitive Compensation** – A fixed salary commensurate with your experience, plus performance-based, uncapped commission and benefits (e.g. pension, health, phone).

Read from our blog why people choose Frends and why Frendszies stay with us.


### **Interested?**


We're looking for the right person, not the fastest hire. If this sounds like you, even if you don't tick every box, we'd like to hear from you. Get in touch and let's connect!


**Additional Information**


* **Start:** Ideally at the beginning of 2027.
* **Contract:** Permanent.
* **Reporting line:** Direct report to the Service Sales Lead, Frends.
* **Process:** Meet at least our People team, the Service Sales Lead, a team member and the leadership team. The process includes a case assignment and reference checks.
* **Please note:** we do not accept applications submitted by email.

title: Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
description:
**HAYPP GROUP**


We address one of the world’s biggest problems – how to end smoking. There are 1,1 billion smokers in the world. Around 8 million people die every year from smoking-related diseases. Our goal is to significantly reduce death rates, save lives and inspire people to choose smoke-free enjoyment. How? By offering people other nicotine products online.


Haypp Group is one of the Nordics’ leading e-commerce groups with eleven store brands, present in seven countries where we serve more than 1 million active consumers. Through brands such as Snusbolaget.se, Northerner.com, Nicokick.com etc., we sell nicotine pouches, Swedish style snus online as well as disposable vapes. With our headquarters located on Östgötagatan in Stockholm we are 300 team members mainly but not exclusively based in Sweden. Also, we are an innovative and fast-moving company that is growing rapidly, driving sustainable business and are changing the world in the process. We are currently on an exciting expansion journey, converting more and more smokers to smoke-free alternatives across all our markets globally.

 **READY TO BUILD THE CLOUD FOUNDATION OUR DATA RUNS ON?**


Want to help shape the cloud infrastructure behind our internal platforms? As Cloud Infrastructure Engineer at Haypp, you’ll design, build and run secure, scalable infrastructure on Google Cloud (GCP) and AWS, working hand in hand with our Data Team to deliver the internal platforms they rely on every day.


If you love infrastructure as code and solving hard problems with an engineering mindset, this is your chance to make a real impact.

 **WHAT YOU'LL DO**


Your role as a Cloud Infrastructure Engineer will be diverse and hands-on. Working closely with our colleague Khan and the rest of our Group IT team to deliver top-of-the-line cloud infrastructure, you’ll:

* Design, build and operate cloud infrastructure on GCP and AWS, covering networking, compute, storage, and managed services, with security, reliability, and cost efficiency built in.
* Codify everything with Terraform using reusable modules, remote state, and automated plan/apply pipelines (e.g. GitHub Actions), with peer review for every change.
* Partner with the Data Team to deliver the internal infrastructure behind our data platform, creating secure, self-service environments for storage, pipelines, and analytics using services such as BigQuery, Cloud Storage, and Pub/Sub.
* Drive our move from AWS to GCP by assessing workloads, mapping services, and executing migrations with clear cutover and rollback plans. You’ll also decommission infrastructure we no longer need.
* Build security in from day one through least-privilege IAM, workload identity, secrets and key management, network segmentation, encryption, and policy-as-code guardrails across both clouds.
* Automate repetitive work with scripting in Python, Bash, or Go, while keeping documentation, runbooks, and architecture decisions up to date.
* Keep our platforms observable and resilient through monitoring, logging and alerting, backup and disaster recovery, incident response, and continuous cost optimization.

**EXAMPLES OF PROJECTS YOU MIGHT MANAGE**

* Migrating selected workloads from AWS to GCP. For example, moving data from Amazon S3 to Cloud Storage and re-platforming services onto GKE, with minimal downtime.
* Building a secure GCP landing zone in Terraform: resource hierarchy, shared VPC networking, IAM, organization policies, and centralized logging.
* Delivering self-service infrastructure for the Data Team: Terraform modules and templates that let them spin up compliant environments quickly and consistently.
* Implementing centralized secrets management with Google Secret Manager and AWS Secrets Manager.
* Designing backup and disaster recovery strategies across clouds and running regular failover tests.
* Building observability dashboards and alerting (e.g., Grafana, Datadog) for platform health, cost, and security posture.

**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR**

**The essentials**

* 4+ years of experience in Cloud, Platform, DevOps, or Infrastructure Engineering, working with production environments.
* Strong hands-on experience with **GCP and AWS**, with deep expertise in at least one of them.
* Strong experience with **Terraform** and infrastructure as code.
* A solid understanding of **cloud security**, including IAM, network security, encryption, and secrets management.
* Good knowledge of **cloud networking and Linux**.
* Experience with scripting or programming in **Python, Bash, or Go**.
* Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to communicate technical topics clearly.

**Nice to have**

* Experience with cloud migrations, especially from AWS to GCP.
* Experience with data platforms and services such as BigQuery, Pub/Sub, Dataflow, or Airflow.
* Familiarity with Azure or Cloudflare.
* Relevant cloud or infrastructure certifications, such as Google Cloud, AWS, Terraform, or Kubernetes certifications.

**YOU'LL THRIVE HERE IF YOU**

* Like taking ownership, from shaping a solution to seeing it work in production.
* Enjoy collaborating and turning different needs into practical, scalable solutions.
* Are curious and pragmatic, and enjoy finding the right balance between doing things properly and getting things done.
* Like sharing what you know and learning from the people around you.

**WHAT WE OFFER**


We are a value driven company with our values *We team up*, *Innovation Drives Us*, *Inclusion and Non-Hierarchy* and *Going the Extra Mile* at the heartbeat of everything that we do. With us you can always expect to get help from people who want to achieve things together and to be able to speak your mind in every social constellation you are part of. We highly value all ideas no matter where they come from, and we are not afraid to try new things out. We are also welcoming, inclusive and everyone at Haypp Group has a voice. In addition, we seize opportunities by putting in hands-on, hard work and celebrating when we reach our goals. With us, you should always feel safe, appreciated and valued but at the same time challenged and excited.


Because we recognize that our team members are our most important differentiator, we offer our team members generous benefits. We offer the following perks to everyone at Haypp Group:

* Competitive occupational pension
* Insurance plan, including private healthcare
* 30 days of paid vacation
* Parental pay lift
* Wellness allowance of 5,000 SEK per year
* Lots of social happenings

**SEND US YOUR APPLICATION TODAY!**


If this sounds like a place where you would want to contribute and grow, let us know you’re interested by submitting your application!


Haypp Group is committed to equality and diversity, and we welcome applications from all qualified individuals regardless of ethnicity, religion, age, gender, sexual orientation, disability, and marital status. We want to offer you great recruitment experience, and if there is anything we can do to make you more comfortable in the process with us, please let us know.

  

If you have any questions about the role or what it’s like to work at Haypp Group in general, feel free to reach out to our responsible recruiter Lea Sjösten at lea.sjosten@hayppgroup.com.


**Please note that applications should be submitted through the application form, not by email. This allows us to handle your personal data securely and makes your application available to the full hiring team.**


We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Data Center Technician
description:
**Overview**  

As a Microsoft Data Center Technician (DCT), you will stage, set up and perform hardware deployments. In addition, you will also perform troubleshooting and diagnostics on equipment, as well as perform hardware decommissions for simple changes and refreshes following Standard Operating Procedures. This opportunity will allow you to deepen your understanding of Data Center standard processes and procedures, develop mentoring skills while providing guidance to peers, familiarizing yourself with security and data management procedures, and accelerate your career growth in the process.

  

Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As a CO+I DCT, you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's online services including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform. As a group, CO+I is focused on the personal and professional development of all employees and offers training and growth opportunities including Career Rotation Programs, Diversity & Inclusion training and events, and professional certifications.

  

Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 200 Data Centers in 32 countries and millions of servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide.

  

With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our data center design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve as we meet the ever-changing business demands that hold Microsoft as a world-class cloud provider.

  

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

 **Responsibilities**  

* Performs diagnostics and troubleshooting following standard procedures, quickly identifies the cause(s) of issues, and replaces faulty components with minimal customer and business disruption.
* Performs post-execution quality checks and verifies that grounding, staging, labeling, and cabling are set up properly according to safety protocols, deployment standards, and planned Network Design Tasks (NDTs).
* Decommissions hardware for simple changes and refreshes (e.g., memory upgrades, rebuilds) following standard procedures with minimal guidance.
* Follows procedures to communicate, report, and escalate incidents to appropriate Microsoft data center operations management units, Technician Leads, and engineering specialists.
* Assists and provides guidance to other technicians to complete challenging or complex tasks.
* Completes required training aligned to the role and workload; observes more experienced technicians to gain hands-on experience and relevant on-the-job training.
* Contributes to a positive and effective team environment by sharing information with others, contributing to regular team meetings, asking questions, and staying apprised of the status of others' work.
* Has pride and a sense of accountability for the service quality, completeness, and resulting user experience; displays accountability and ownership of the data center facilities.
* Embodies our culture and values

  

**Qualifications** **Required Qualifications****:**

* Completed High/Secondary School, GED, an apprenticeship/vocational qualification, or equivalent experience and basic knowledge of computer hardware and components.
* Experienced in diagnostics, troubleshooting , route cause analysis of hardware deployments.
* Experience of Decommissioning and Upgrading hardware.
* You may be required to travel between sites as part of this role so a valid driver’s license will be required.

 **Background Check Requirements:**


Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:

* Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

  

While not required, we also look for the following **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience supporting IT equipment or related technology.
* Applicable certifications: CompTIA (A+, Server+, Network+), Basic Structure Cabling (BSC).

Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 200 datacenters in 32 countries and millions of servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide.With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our datacenter design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve as we meet the ever-changing business demands that hold Microsoft as a world-class cloud provider.  


Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.  

**Responsibilities**  

* Serve as an operations specialist in one major area of CE operations (e.g., electrical, mechanical, controls, generators) and works on advanced tasks independently.
* Inspect and supervise critical environment-related facility equipment (e.g., controls, heating, ventilation, and air conditioning [HVAC], mechanical systems), building, and grounds regularly for unsafe or abnormal conditions and escalate per applicable policies and standards.
* Utilize internal computerized maintenance management system (CMMS) to track all equipment assets and to complete work order requests for maintenance work.
* Safely and quickly respond to and leads onsite incident response teams for all abnormal conditions that impact operations, and coordinates with other critical facilities professionals to perform corrective repairs without supervision.
* Enhance, develop new or follow preexisting emergency operating procedures (EOPs), methods of procedure (MOPs), and standard operating procedures (SOPs) in relation to CE operations and incidents.
* Perform various types of maintenance (e.g., planned, predictive, corrective) and repairs following methods of procedure (MOPs), and standard operating procedures (SOPs) for CE equipment (e.g., electrical, mechanical, cooling systems) and escalate when appropriate.
* Have a hands-on understanding of how equipment works and how to troubleshoot equipment, systems, subsystems, and components independently within their trained discipline(s).
* Provides consultation to lower-level colleagues in troubleshooting systems and problems.
* Understands, follows, and ensures safety and security requirements (e.g., job hazard assessments [JHAs], environmental health and safety (EH&S), toolbox talks), and business processes and procedures to properly perform work in a safe, quality, and reliable manner in accordance with applicable federal, state, local, and Microsoft requirements.
* Embody our culture and values.

  

**Qualifications**  

**Required Qualifications:*** High School Diploma, GED, or equivalent AND relevant experience in mission critical services work/applied learning experience (e.g., high availability assembly/manufacturing/critical infrastructure environments such as data centers, oil and gas refineries, hospitals, pharmaceutical, manufacturing, or related fields) OR equivalent experience.

* Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.



While not required, we also look for the following **Preferred Qualifications:*** High School Diploma, GED, or equivalent AND extensive experience in mission critical services experience (e.g., high-availability assembly/manufacturing/critical infrastructure environments such as data centers, oil and gas refineries, hospitals, pharmaceutical, manufacturing, or related fields)

title: Senior Manager, Engineering Governance & Compliance
description:
**Job Overview**
----------------


Interested in shaping how Arm develops safe, secure and reliable products as technology and industry expectations continue to change?


We are looking for a Senior Manager, Engineering Governance & Compliance to join our Central Engineering Quality and Compliance team.


At Arm, we strive to keep pace with new standards and regulations while making our development practices simpler and more effective. With this exciting new role, we want to bring the best ideas from across the industry, improve how we work and leverage AI and automation to reduce unnecessary effort and establish clarity and consistency.


This is a fantastic opportunity to work closely with Engineering teams, challenge existing practices, introduce practical improvements and help us prepare for what's next!


**Responsibilities**
--------------------


* Own, develop and improve Quality and Functional Safety frameworks, processes, templates and engineering methodologies across IP, software and systems.
* Prepare Arm for emerging standards and regulations, assessing applicability, identifying gaps and introducing relevant industry best practices.
* Improve engineering methods and quality reviews, accross Arm broad portfolio- from Cloud AI and Edge AI to Physical AI, working with Engineering teams to strengthen quality criteria, simplify activities and integrate compliance into existing development workflows, from requirements through verification.
* Explore AI and automation for Quality and Compliance, developing solutions that reduce manual work, improve consistency and make assurance more efficient.
* Provide independent governance and compliance oversight and build capability, advising Engineering leaders, delivering training and strengthening competence across Arm.

**Required Skills and Experience**
----------------------------------


* Experience in engineering quality, compliance or methodology development within semiconductor hardware, software or complex systems.
* Knowledge of relevant industry standards and engineering best practices, particularly Automotive SPICE, Functional Safety and Cybersecurity.
* Good understanding of semiconductor and software development lifecycles, with the ability to translate complex requirements into practical methods.
* Experience leading cross-functional improvements, influencing senior stakeholders and challenging established practices constructively.
* Strong communication, analytical and problem-solving skills, with experience developing technical teams or delivering training.

**Nice-to-Have Skills and Experience**
--------------------------------------


* Experience applying AI, automation or data analytics to improve engineering processes would be valuable. Knowledge of emerging regulations, including the EU AI Act, and experience in Automotive, AI/ML or Robotics would also be welcome.

**In Return**
-------------


At Arm, you'll join a collaborative and supportive global team, working at the forefront of Automotive, Robotics, and Physical AI technologies. This is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact in our Central Engineering Quality and Compliance team., helping shape the quality, safety, and reliability of next-generation technologies.
  

  

You'll work alongside experienced engineering and quality professionals, with opportunities to develop your expertise, influence engineering practices, and contribute to continuous improvement across Arm.
  

  

We offer a welcoming, inclusive, and high-performance working environment, alongside opportunities for professional development and a competitive benefits package.


**Additional Information**
--------------------------


Please note that a relocation package (including visa sponsorship support) is available for this role, for candidates who require it.


#LI-BPW


**Our 10x Mindset**
-------------------


At Arm, we believe progress happens when people are empowered to think bigger and push beyond what seems possible. Our 10x mindset is about curiosity, ambition and creating impact that will be used by millions. We learn fast, prioritise collaboration and turn bold ideas into real technology. We look for people who are inspired by this way of working and want to grow in an environment where bold ideas are welcomed. Discover how the 10x mindset shapes life at Arm: https://careers.arm.com/10x-mindset (opens in new window)


**Use of AI in Your Application**
---------------------------------


At Arm, we embrace the benefits AI can bring, including in recruitment. You may use AI to support your preparation, such as improving the clarity of written responses, practicing interview questions, or learning more about our industry. However, your application and interview responses must reflect your own thinking, experience, and abilities. We want to understand your authentic perspective, creativity, and approach to problem solving. As such, you may not use AI to complete assigned tasks as part of any assessments. If you plan to use AI-supported or assistive technologies as part of a reasonable adjustment, please contact accommodations@arm.com so we can support you.


**Recruitment Adjustments and Accommodations**
----------------------------------------------


At Arm, we want to build extraordinary teams. If you need an adjustment or an accommodation during the recruitment process, please email accommodations@arm.com. To note, by sending us the requested information, you consent to its use by Arm to arrange for appropriate accommodations. All accommodation or adjustment requests will be treated with confidentiality, and information concerning these requests will only be disclosed as necessary to provide the accommodation. Although this is not an exhaustive list, examples of support include breaks between interviews, having documents read aloud, or office accessibility. Please email us about anything we can do to accommodate you during the recruitment process.


**Hybrid Working**
------------------


Arm’s approach to hybrid working is designed to create a working environment that supports both high performance and personal wellbeing. We believe in bringing people together face to face to enable us to work at pace, whilst recognizing the value of flexibility. Within that framework, we empower groups/teams to determine their own hybrid working patterns, depending on the work and the team’s needs. Details of what this means for each role will be shared upon application. In some cases, the flexibility we can offer is limited by local legal, regulatory, tax, or other considerations, and where this is the case, we will collaborate with you to find the best solution. Please talk to us to find out more about what this could look like for you.


**Equal Opportunities**
-----------------------


Arm is an equal opportunity employer, committed to providing an environment of mutual respect where equal opportunities are available to all applicants and colleagues. We are a diverse organization of dedicated and innovative individuals, and don’t discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

-----------------

title: Systemingenjör inom komplexa mjukvarusystem
description:
##### **Om kunden**


Vår kund är verksam inom avancerad teknikutveckling och utvecklar komplexa mjukvarubaserade ledningssystem för marina tillämpningar. Systemen används på bland annat fartyg och ubåtar och sammanför information från sensorer, datalänkar och andra delsystem för att skapa ett samlat beslutsunderlag.


Verksamheten befinner sig i en expansiv fas där etablerade system vidareutvecklas parallellt med initiativ inom bland annat cloud, AI, modellbaserad utveckling och framtida autonoma lösningar. Du blir en del av en miljö med hög teknisk komplexitet, långsiktiga projekt och goda möjligheter att på sikt kunna utvecklas mot exempelvis tekniskt ledarskap, specialistkompetens eller arkitektur.

##### **Om tjänsten**


Som systemingenjör får du en central roll genom hela utvecklingskedjan. Du arbetar huvudsakligen på systemnivå med att förstå kundens behov, bryta ned krav och omsätta dem till genomtänkta tekniska lösningar. Rollen är mjukvarunära, men fokus ligger på kravhantering, systemdesign och integration snarare än egen kodutveckling.


Du arbetar vanligtvis i ett eller två parallella projekt och samarbetar nära tekniska projektledare, arkitekter, integratörer och testingenjörer. Beroende på var projektet befinner sig kan du även arbeta med verifiering, kundutbildning och implementation.


Dina arbetsuppgifter omfattar bland annat att:

* Analysera och bryta ned kundkrav
* Formulera och hantera systemkrav
* Ta fram systemdesign och beskriva tekniska lösningar
* Säkerställa att krav och design omsätts korrekt inom integration och test
* Arbeta med dokumentation och kravspårning
* Delta i verifiering och test på systemnivå
* Samordna tekniska frågor mellan olika kompetensområden
* Bidra med teknisk vägledning och stötta mindre erfarna kollegor


Resor inom och utanför Sverige kan förekomma beroende på projektfas och kundbehov.

##### **Din kompetens**


Vi söker dig som har:

* Erfarenhet av kravarbete i komplexa systemmiljöer
* Erfarenhet av mjukvaruutveckling eller mjukvarunära systemutveckling
* Erfarenhet av systemdesign
* Praktisk erfarenhet av verifiering och test på systemnivå
* Erfarenhet av tekniskt ledarskap eller förmåga att ta en ledande roll i projekt
* Högre teknisk utbildning, exempelvis civilingenjör eller motsvarande
* Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska
* Vana av strukturerat arbete med teknisk dokumentation och kravhantering


Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av DOORS eller liknande kravhanteringsverktyg. Bakgrund inom mjukvaruutveckling är också värdefull, liksom erfarenhet av cloud, AI, modellbaserad utveckling eller autonoma system.


Som person är du självgående och initiativtagande med ett strukturerat och analytiskt arbetssätt. Rollen har många kontaktytor, vilket gör att du behöver trivas med tekniskt samarbete och kunna kommunicera komplexa frågor på ett tydligt sätt.

**Tjänsten är säkerhetsklassad och innebär att du behöver bli godkänd i en säkerhetsprövning. I samband med detta kan krav på visst medborgarskap förekomma.**

##### **Övrigt**


Lön: Fast månadslön


Omfattning: Heltid, tillsvidare


Start: Omgående med hänsyn tagen till din eventuella uppsägningstid


Placeringsort: Stockholm


Vi behandlar ansökningar löpande och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan ansökningstiden har gått ut, skicka din ansökan redan idag!

##### **Om oss**


Procruitment är Sveriges enda karriärbyrå inom IT, tech och engineering som genom proaktiv rekrytering förenar attraktiva arbetsgivare med människor som delar samma mål och ambitioner. Oavsett om du är en erfaren ledare eller om du ska ta ditt första steg ut i karriären hjälper vi dig att nå dina karriärmål - samtidigt som vi bryr oss om dig, din resa och att du mår bra längs vägen.  

  

Procruitment är stolta vinnare av Recruitment Awards och är utsedda till ***Årets Rekryteringsföretag*** och ***Årets Raket***samt ***Gasellföretag 2024*** *av* Dagens Industri*.*

title: AI-arkitekt
description:
Som **AI-arkitekt hos B3 Cloud** får du en central roll i att designa och utveckla AI-lösningar som hjälper våra kunder att omsätta tekniska möjligheter till konkret verksamhetsnytta. Du kombinerar djup teknisk förståelse med ett helhetsperspektiv och ansvarar för att skapa arkitekturer som är säkra, skalbara och hållbara över tid.


Du arbetar med att ta fram lösningsarkitektur för AI-baserade applikationer, exempelvis AI-agenter, RAG-lösningar och lösningar baserade på generativ AI. Det innebär att du utvärderar tekniker och modeller, fattar tekniska designbeslut och skapar förutsättningar för hur AI ska integreras med system, data och verksamhetsprocesser.


Du vägleder utvecklingsteam, granskar tekniska lösningar och säkerställer att arkitekturen uppfyller krav på säkerhet, prestanda, kvalitet och kostnadseffektivitet. Du hjälper också kunder att navigera bland nya AI-tekniker och välja lösningar som fungerar både idag och på längre sikt.


Vi tror att du är analytisk, nyfiken och har förmågan att se både detaljer och helhet. Du trivs i en rådgivande roll, tycker om att dela med dig av din kunskap och har ett stort intresse för hur AI kan användas för att lösa verkliga utmaningar.

**Vi söker dig som:**

* har minst **5 års erfarenhet av lösningsarkitektur eller systemarkitektur**, med fokus på mjukvaruutveckling, integrationer och molnbaserade lösningar.
* har **praktisk erfarenhet av AI-lösningar** och god förståelse för generativ AI, stora språkmodeller (LLM) och AI-agenter.
* kan **designa skalbara AI-arkitekturer**, exempelvis med RAG, agentbaserade lösningar och integrationer mot externa system.
* har **god erfarenhet av Microsoft Azure** och förståelse för hur molntjänster används för att utveckla och driftsätta AI-lösningar.
* besitter god kompetens inom **API, systemintegrationer och datahantering.**
* har god förståelse för **säkerhet, identitet och åtkomsthantering i moderna applikationsmiljöer.**
* kommunicerar obehindrat på **svenska och engelska** i tal och skrift, då det krävs i det dagliga arbetet.
*Meriterande:*

* **Konsultvana**, med erfarenhet av kunddialog och att omsätta verksamhetens behov till tekniska lösningar.
* Erfarenhet av **Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI och Claude**
* Kunskap om **agentramverk, exempelvis Semantic Kernel eller Microsoft Agent Framework.**
* Kunskap om **AI-governance, Responsible AI och relevanta regelverk,** exempelvis EU AI Act.

**Vilka är vi?**


Vi är B3 Cloud, ett härligt gäng med specialistkunskaper inom molntjänster utspridda i Göteborg och Stockholm. Vi tror på att dela kunskap, stötta varandra och ständigt utvecklas tillsammans – både som team och som individer.


Som en del av B3 Consulting Group har vi resurser, kompetens och stöd i ryggen samtidigt som vi bibehåller dynamik och flexibilitet med korta beslutsvägar. Vi är stolt över att vara del av en verksamhet som präglas av inkludering och en strävan efter att ha en positiv påverkan på samhället, människor och miljön. Vi värdesätter olikheter och erfarenheter och arbetar kontinuerligt med inkludering och kultur för samarbete och respekt.

*Vi erbjuder:*

* **Frihet och flexibilitet** att påverka din utveckling, arbetstider och uppdrag
* **Kompetensutveckling** genom utbildningar, certifieringar och lunchföreläsningar
* **Konkurrenskraftig lönemodell** och en otroligt flexibel samt förmånlig RAM modell.
* **En givande företagskultur** med konferensresor, AW:s och wellness-aktiviteter

**Vår ambition inom AI**


På B3 Cloud bygger vi nu upp flera starka erbjudande inom AI, med utgångspunkt i det vi redan kan väl: molnet, Microsofts plattformar och nära samarbete med kundernas verksamheter.


Som AI-arkitekt blir du en central del av den här satsningen. Du får möjlighet att påverka hur vårt AI-erbjudande växer, vilka områden vi satsar på och hur vi arbetar framåt. Här finns utrymme att testa nya idéer, dela kunskap med kollegor i hela B3 och bygga något tillsammans från tidigt skede.
